relevance_note: Cohort study of AxD patients with GFAP variants that describes individual patients, e.g. "One patient with limited expressive language was noted to rub the occipital area of her head constantly."
method_note: Natural-history cohort: 85 enrolled, 43 underwent LP (n_patients_reported=43; cohort_size_as_stated=85, the natural-history enrollment). All enrolled patients had a 'pathologic variant in GFAP' (eligibility statement), but no variant is printed for anyone, so each in-scope person has one GFAP row with variant_original_string 'not reported'; pathogenicity left 'not reported' because the only source is the enrollment criterion. Only four people get individual-level facts and have rows: the two acetazolamide-treated patients (unnamed person 1, 2), the additional patient with pre-enrollment headache/papilledema (unnamed person 3; the Discussion sentence 'An additional patient had a history of headaches, irritability, and elevated OP and neurosurgical interventions were ultimately pursued' was taken to be the same person), and the single obese adult whose OP was not elevated (unnamed person 4). Other one-line mentions (e.g. patient with outside-hospital follow-up LP, 2 deaths, 4 with OP >36) are counts or procedural notes without features and got no rows. Elevated OP was mapped to 'hydrocephalus or raised intracranial pressure' only where the OP exceeded the paper's stated >28 cm H_2O cutoff. Papilledema 'excluded' for persons 1 and 2 comes from the sentence naming 'The 2 individuals' (group statement); person 1 later had 'early papilledema' considered alongside pseudopapilledema, so papilledema itself was not marked observed for her (hedged) and the exam finding was recorded as stated. Headache for person 4 is excluded from 'The remaining patients were asymptomatic without headaches'. Cohort-level statements ('other imaging findings of obstructive hydrocephalus were not present among any of the patients') were not used for checklist exclusions because 'other' findings is narrower than the composite item. No tables give per-patient data; no stacked cells. Built with a short Python script; all spans checked verbatim by script.
